description.value:
Frequency once per day

You blow a cloud of magical dust and tiny scales, enchanting those who inhale it. Roll 1d6 to determine the dust's effects. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC, and is affected as if it got the same outcome on a Will save against the rolled spell.

1–3 The dust has the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Charm] spell.

4–6 The dust has the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Sleep] spell.
